articleTitle: A Modified Fast Back-Projection Algorithm for mini-UAV-borne FMCW SAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Frequency-modulation continuous-wave (FMCW) synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) is very suitable for installation on miniature unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) due to its low power consumption and miniaturization. However, the large pulse width of its transmitted signal leads the "stop and go" assumption in the traditional pulsed radar is no longer valid. It is necessary to compensate the influence caused by intra pulse motion in imaging processing. The traditional BP algorithm is difficult to implement due to its high computational complexity. Fortunately, the fast BP (FBP) is a way to fix this problem. However, the intra pulse motion is not considered in the traditional FBP algorithm. This paper proposes a modified FBP algorithm to compensate the influence introduced by intra pulse motion of FMCW SAR. Firstly, the influence of intra pulse motion is discussed. Second, a modified FBP algorithm for compensating intra pulse motion is introduced. Finally, the results of simulation data experiments are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Lidar-Camera Fusion Based on KD-Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The main sensors of self-driving cars are lidar and camera; this paper proposes a new fusion method. First, the image is de-distorted, and the noise points are filtered out by the KD-Tree algorithm. Finally, through coordinate transformation, the pixel RGB information of the image is assigned to the lidar point cloud, the fusion of lidar and image is realized. The kitti dataset is used in this experiment, use Yolov5 neural network for target detection and recognition, and the fusion effect is demonstrated by the ROS system; the results show that this method not only shortens the processing time by 62.36%, but also improves the sensor fusion accuracy by 18.89%.

articleTitle: Comprehensive performance evaluation of intrusion detection model based on radar chart method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional performance evaluation methods can not accurately evaluate the performance of intrusion detection model, a comprehensive performance evaluation method of intrusion detection model based on radar chart method is proposed. According to the five basic evaluation indexes of accuracy, precision, recall, specificity and F1 score, a comprehensive performance evaluation method of intrusion detection model based on radar chart method is proposed. Finally, on the NSL-KDD dataset, the comprehensive performance of five common machine learning models is analyzed by radar chart method. The simulation results show that the comprehensive performance evaluation method of the intrusion detection model based on the radar chart method can comprehensively and objectively reflect the comprehensive performance of the intrusion detection model, and provide a theoretical basis for the performance analysis, optimization and decision-making of the intrusion detection model.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Bid Fraud Prediction Model Based on AdaBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of Internet big data technology and e-commerce platform, many active offline transaction methods have gradually shifted to online. Online auctions have come a long way due to COVID-19, but bidding fraud has seriously disrupted the health of the industry. In this paper, the AdaBoost model is used to build a bidding fraud prediction model, and the prediction performance of the model is verified by data experiments, and it is found that it has a high accuracy for identifying bidding fraud. At present, there are few prediction models for bidding fraud, and it has broad development prospects.

articleTitle: Sound signal processing and sound source positioning device
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The system consists of a microphone array module, a signal conditioning circuit, a RK1808 edge computing core board, a controllable rotating pan tilt module, a laser pen head and its driving circuit, and an external stable bracket to form a sound signal processing and sound source positioning device. It includes sound signal collected by microphone in real time, real-time display of sound source position distance and angle information, real-time tracking of sound source motion state and drawing corresponding motion image. The RK1808 edge computing core board is used to process the sound signal collected by the microphone array, obtain the distance and angle information of the sound source, and transmit it to the microcontroller unit (MCU), so as to control the PTZ equipped with a laser pen to point to the sound source. RK1808 with built-in computing power up to 3.0 TOPs ensures the efficiency of locating sound source, and then uses adaptive filtering algorithm to eliminate noise interference. This design has the advantages of high anti-interference, low power consumption, low cost, high accuracy, etc., and meets the needs of modern sound signal processing and sound source positioning devices.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of classical neural network algorithms in emotion recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Emotion recognition with computer-assisted methods has been an important tool for psychological analysis. Traditional approaches based on designing and extracting various features of multi-channel neurophysiological signals may require extensive knowledge of this field. This can be a sophisticated task for any expert. In this paper, we examined a hybrid model that utilizes ‘Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)’ for feature extraction and ‘Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)’ that incorporates contextual information. Through the method proposed in this paper, the information that needs to be processed is optimized through multi-channel processing. At the same time, the signal data are packaged into different grid frames by the method of scale transformation, and finally the preprocessing is realized. The whole experiment process is carried out using the publicly available DEAP dataset. The final comparison result based on Valence and Arousal classification accuracy demonstrates that our method is effective.

articleTitle: Time-frequency Joint Frequency Offset Estimation Algorithm for GMSK Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: As an emerging communication networking method, airborne data link plays an increasingly important role in the field of defense and civil use, and GMSK is widely used in airborne data link networking systems with its efficient frequency band utilization and power utilization. However, the high-speed movement of the UAV will inevitably produce Doppler frequency offset, which will greatly affect the performance of the communication system receiver, so this paper proposes a pilot-based time domain indirect estimation algorithm with low complexity implementation, and compares the performance of different pilot placement positions. At the same time, in order to make up for the shortcomings of the small estimation range of the algorithm, a time-frequency joint frequency offset estimation algorithm is further proposed, which first coarsely estimates and compensates the received signal through FFT and Quinn algorithms, and then uses the pilot-based frequency offset indirect estimation algorithm to accurately estimate the received signal. The algorithm not only takes into account the high estimation range of the frequency domain estimation algorithm, but also has the high accuracy of the time domain estimation algorithm, and can also have high performance under the condition of low SNR.

articleTitle: Power-Management with Read-Write Assistant Single Port SRAM for Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the explosive growth of social demand for calculation power and the developing of extensive applications of smart devices loading with the System on Chip(SoC). SRAM occupies a large mount of SoC power consumption. This paper proposes a new structure using in single port SRAM which can implement low-power data storage. The Structure using power management circuit and read-write assistant circuit working together to reduces the power consumption during non read/write period effectively. The read-write assistant circuit can reduce the worst working voltage of SRAM (Vmin) through the capacitor structure. This structure using in single port SRAM Compiler Tape-out by SMIC 14nm FinFET process. Verified the single port SRAM with this structure help SRAM read/write successfully to acquire an excellent power performance. The result tested by ADVANTEST V93000 test platform.

articleTitle: Patch-Range Attention and Visual Transformer for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) task has attracted a lot of interests, particularly in human-computer interaction file. Many existing methods based on Convolutional Neural Network have been frequently used for the task of FER. However, convolutional filters in CNN rely heavily on the spatial locality, and are unable to learn the global features of facial expression at the beginning of the model. With the stacking of convolutional layers, the deep convolutional layer can extract global features, which however are incomplete in most instances. Therefore, the capacity of the model based on CNN is still insufficient for FER. In order to solve this problem, our paper proposes a different FER model that is made up of Patch-Range-Attention (PRA), Vision Transformer (ViT) and Squeeze-Excitation for the FER task. Our proposed method is accessed on four public FER datasets. The results on these four FER databases strongly prove our PVS model outperforms state-of-the-art models by a large margin.

articleTitle: Trapezoidal Shaping Algorithm based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In the field of nuclear detection, multi-channel pulse amplitude analysis technology is the basic method of nuclear radiation energy spectrum measurement. According to the requirements of the digital multi-channel pulse amplitude analyzer, the trapezoidal shaping algorithm is demonstrated mathematically and simulated in MATLAB. In addition, a structure of trapezoidal shaping module based on FPGA is proposed in this paper. Fixed-point and floating-point operations are strictly separated in this structure to save hardware resources. The whole module adopts pipeline design to reduce data flow delay and improve system performance. It is simulated in Modelsim. The result reaches expectation.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring System of Expressway Mechanical and Electrical Facilities Based on SCADA-HMI
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Modern expressway construction is generally divided into two parts: basic road construction and traffic management equipment system construction. The former provides basic conditions for road operation, while the latter can provide solid data support for the former. Therefore, real-time monitoring can improve road operation quality. In view of the deficiency of information command coordination in traditional expressway electromechanical facilities monitoring system, this paper studies expressway electromechanical facilities remote monitoring system. In terms of system structure, SCADA/HMI functional architecture is used to achieve hierarchical management. In the system software, the dynamic information collection function is added, and the communication protocol and central database are used to issue commands to electromechanical facilities; Determine the average working time under fault free condition through the traffic RAMS management system, and then realize remote monitoring according to SCADA/HMI. The test results show that the average response time of the proposed system is 22.026s, and the monitoring accuracy is maintained at more than 90%, which can meet the requirements for remote monitoring of electromechanical facilities.

articleTitle: Analysis of the implementation method of network security in the logical security domain of edge power secondary integration equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In order to explore the realization method of network security in the logical security domain of primary and secondary integration devices of edge power, a realization method of network security in the logical security domain based on primary and secondary integration devices of edge power is proposed. This method recommended key technical problems and solutions based on information represented by edge power, and explored the research of network security in the logical security domain of edge power primary and secondary integration equipment. The research shows that the efficiency of realizing network security in the logical security domain based on the primary-secondary integration of edge power equipment is about 30% higher than that of traditional methods. With the development of intelligent distribution network, distribution automation has been popularized, and distribution network will be closer to transmission network in automation degree, which makes the theory of distribution system security domain (DSSR) become a reality.

articleTitle: Research on spatial data management and application
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The characteristics of spatial data, such as wide variety, rapid growth of data production, and complex application, pose new challenges to spatial data information services. The research of this paper aims to meet the unified and efficient management of multi-source and heterogeneous data. Through data resource integration and information system integration, the ability of spatial data collection, aggregation, processing, analysis, sharing and service is comprehensively improved. Supported by service-oriented architecture, heterogeneous spatial data sharing based on Service GIS and data integration of multiple data sources based on different communication protocols, the system architecture is designed with spatial data exchange and service platform as the core. It supports the deployment of distributed spatial data management nodes. Under unified management and scheduling, all operations are published in the form of OGC services. Spatial data is stored in semi/unstructured files or structured tables. A unified, distributed and loosely coupled spatial information service system is built with the spatial data exchange and service platform which can provide basic and spatial data services and analysis and calculation services for existing and new information systems and application development. The spatial data application system establishes a big data resource pool of spatial information gathered from multiple channels, and realizes Informational, intelligent and standardized management in the whole process of data aggregation, data management, dynamic monitoring, business model building, decision support, etc. The system can provide comprehensive spatial data resource support, build an accurate spatial data service business model, and provide intelligent decision support for emergency rescue based on spatial data.

articleTitle: Underwater acoustic target recognition technology based on MFA-Conformer
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Passive sonar underwater target recognition usually includes feature extraction and classification. In the early research, the above tasks were completed by sonar personnel, but the method of artificial feature extraction is easy to lose information and cannot guarantee the recognition accuracy and efficiency. Therefore, more efficient automatic recognition methods such as deep learning methods are gradually proposed. This paper proposes a new underwater acoustic target recognition network structure: MFA-Conformer, which is simple, efficient and easy to implement. The design of MFA-Conformer is mainly inspired by the recent end-to-end speech recognition network ( Conformer ) and speaker recognition network ( ECAPA-TDNN ): Firstly, a convolution downsampling module is used to downsample the input acoustic features, thereby reducing the computational complexity of the model. Then several different Conformer blocks are used to learn local features and global features. Finally, the output between different Conformer blocks is spliced, and the speech features are extracted through an Attentive Statistics Pooling layer. Apply it to underwater target voiceprint recognition, The network ’s best experimental results achieved an error rate of 1.35% on the Watkin ’s Marine Mammal Sound dataset. Experiments show that compared with the current mainstream voiceprint recognition network structure ECAPA-TDNN, the MFA-Conformer proposed in this paper has greatly improved recognition performance and inference speed.

articleTitle: Study of DC chopper circuit based on MATLAB software
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the background of the DC boost chopper circuit and its application area, build the system model of the DC boost chopper circuit that used Matlab software’s Simulink module, and record the settings of each module parameter, calculate the output voltage theoretical value, output current theoretical value, frequency, and other circuit parameters, record the input and output voltage and current waveforms and observed values, and compare and evaluate the findings. Obtain the output voltage and current waveforms, along with the original data and waveforms, analyze their output voltage and current trends as that of the duty cycle and load type change, and record their waveform graphs. This introduces a brand new theory for interpreting DC chopper circuits in the field of power electrical components.

articleTitle: Influence analysis of noise on sensitivity and 1/f noise removal in a 220GHz radiometer
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: As a high sensitivity receiver system, radiometer is greatly affected by system noise. Noise suppression is important to improve the performance of radiometer. In this paper, the millimeter-wave radiometer is modeled to analyze the influence of noise on the sensitivity of radiometer. A new method of 1/f noise removal based on the parameter estimation of power spectral density (PSD) is proposed. The PSD and sensitivity before and after filtering are obtained by simulation. The results show that our method can effectively remove the 1/f noise.

articleTitle: A Rapid Accident Processing Method Based on Monitoring and Cloud Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The USA and China both reach 300 million cars, and it has attracted much attention how takes scientific and technological innovation as a breakthrough to solve the current problem of traffic congestion. This paper finds a method based on monitoring and cloud technology, it achieves automatic identification of traffic accidents in an unoccupied condition and invents a new model which not only achieves accident processing remotely, but also spends just 11 minutes to complete remote online incident processing. The experiment proves that the new method is significantly more time-saving and efficient than the current accident processing, it has a strong practical significance which facilitates the public, saves social costs, builds intelligent cities, and provides key supporting technologies in the age of driverless cars.

articleTitle: Grey Clustering Model-Based Health Status Assessment of Large Complex Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the development of reliability design techniques, current large complex equipment often has a high level of reliability, which makes it difficult to estimate the health status of equipment with a lack of failure data. Equipment history information is the records of service tasks, failures and usage information during the service period of complex equipment, which play an important role in characterizing the current health status of the equipment. A method for assessing the health status of large complex equipment based on the grey clustering model using equipment history information is proposed, which can convert the subjective uncertainty in expert assessment into objective quantitative evaluation by whitening the weight function. The evaluation results show that the method can better handle the incompleteness in the equipment historical information, which is important for making scientific and reasonable maintenance decisions for large complex equipment.

articleTitle: Front end computer configuration design of power monitoring system based on cloud computing access control
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current power monitoring system front-end computer has poor access control capability, which leads to the long time-consuming of data sending and receiving, a front-end computer configuration method for power monitoring system based on cloud computing access control is designed. The BQ4011YMA-100 chip is selected as the core chip of the front-end computer, and the peripheral circuit and network interface of the chip are set. Build a cloud computing access control model, analyze the reliability of data receiving nodes according to the AHP, and control access security. Set the front-end data transceiver program to realize the front-end configuration data transceiver function of the power monitoring system. So far, the design of the front-end computer configuration method of the power monitoring system based on cloud computing access control is completed. Build a test link to analyze the front-end function after this configuration method is used. The test results show that this configuration method can shorten the data sending and receiving time to a certain extent and improve the performance of the system.

articleTitle: Dual-station Passive Tracking Algorithm based on Cubature Kalman Filter Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In dual-station passive tracking, the Cubature Kalman Filter(CKF) algorithm is widely concerned. To improve the trscking precision of CKF algorithm, a dual-station passive tracking algorithm based on Cubature Kalman Filter smoothing(CKFS) is proposed. In this paper, Cubature Kalman Filter is used as forward-filtering to provide current location results, and smoothing the previous state vector and covariance matrix using the current location results. Therefore an initial value with higher precision is obtained to get more precisely locating results. comparative analysis and validation are made on the tracking performances of CKF algorithm and CKFS algorithm, and the experiment results show that, under the same conditions, the CKFS can more effectively improve the tracking precision than the CKF algorithm. The CKFS algorithm can reduce nearly 10% of the position error and nearly 3% of the velocity error.

articleTitle: A Dual Polarization Tightly Coupled Array Antenna Fed by Transformer Balun
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the difficulty of designing the feeding network of the tightly coupled dipole array antenna (TCDA) in the VHF and UHF frequency bands, we design a dual polarization TCDA antenna fed by the transformer Balun. The feeding network is composed of the coaxial line and the transformer Balun. The grounding short-circuit column is used to suppress the E-plane common mode resonance and the FSS layer is used to suppress the H-plane scan impedance mismatch. The simulation results show that the typical VSWR of the antenna is less than 2 in the 110-500MHz band, the VSWR is less than 2.5 in the ± 45° scan angle, and the section height is 275mm, about 1/10λ<inf>low</inf>. The antenna has the characteristics of ultra wide band, wide angle scan, low profile and easy processing.

articleTitle: A Dual-Channel Frequency-Domain Correlation based Fast Algorithm for Estimating Frequency Difference
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Distributed reception of low-orbit satellite signals can improve the flexibility and concealment of the satellite ground equipment. In the distributed receiving system, there exits frequency difference between signals from different stations, which is caused by the motion of the satellite. In order to compensate the difference before signal synthesis, a fast dual-channel correlation algorithm in frequency domain is proposed to estimation the difference, Firstly, the algorithm is deduced in reference to time domain correlation. Then the correlation in frequency domain is converted into multiplication in time domain to improve the operation efficiency. To further improve the performance in low signal-to-noise ratio, a reliable RLS adaptive filtering is introduced to the proposed algorithm. The algorithm is simple and easy to implement and simulate and its results show that it can estimate the frequency difference effectively.

articleTitle: Airport 3D simulation and display system based on Open Source GIS platform
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, China’s air transport industry has developed rapidly, with the rapid growth of flight flow and complexity. The sustained and rapid development of the air transport industry and the continuous expansion of the airport have put forward higher requirements for the operation control of the airport surface. In order to improve the airport operation efficiency and the operation ability under various weather conditions, it is urgent to implement the advanced scene guidance and control system. In order to meet the needs of safe and efficient operation of the airport, civil aviation related enterprises, colleges, training institutions and other units urgently need a simulation system that can quickly present the three-dimensional scene of the airport. On this basis, secondary development based on the airport surface operation simulation system, airport takeoff and landing command system and other services for airport surface monitoring is carried out to simulate various situations of the airport surface, More effectively help controllers conduct targeted analysis, verification and drill.

articleTitle: Near-Field ISAR Imaging Rotational Motion Estimation and Compensation used Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging (ISAR imaging) is a tool for obtaining a radar image of target. The increasing demand on high-resolution ISAR images causes ISAR imaging to become more sensitive to errors. For near-filed radar imaging the complexity of the rotational motion of target must be considered. In this paper, Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm is used to reconstruct the finer range profiles of several prominent points. Depend on these prominent points, we can extract the rotation motion and restore the instantaneous angle. Relying on the angles, we use filtered back projection (FBP) to reconstruct the ISAR image. Simulations and experimental result demonstrate a good performance of the proposed approach in terms of efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on sentiment classification algorithm for Corona Virus Disease 2019 Weibo text
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Since the outbreak of Corona Virus Disease 2019, it has had a significant impact on people’s lives. In order to help the government grasp the social opinion and do more scientific and practical propaganda and public opinion guidance for prevention and control, and to fully reflect people’s attitude toward the epidemic and provide data support for government departments to release epidemic prevention measures. This paper uses Corona Virus Disease 2019-related Weibo comments as the research object and analyzes their sentiment using deep learning algorithms. The number of characters in Weibo comments is usually less than 140, which belongs to the category of short texts. Due to the use of few words, random user language, and irregular grammar, these texts have poor performance in text separation and word vector expression, adversely affecting sentiment classification. In order to solve this problem, this paper constructs the BERT-DPCNN model for sentiment analysis of epidemic short texts, which can not only extract the sentence-level text dependencies but also effectively avoid the problem of gradient disappearance of deep neural networks. The experiments show that the BERT-DPCNN model has the best effect and is of great value for the sentiment classification of short epidemic text.

articleTitle: PCB bare board defect detection and recognition system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: PCB bare board as a carrier of electronic products to achieve the function, its quality directly determines the life of electronic products, and whether function is normal to achieve. This paper introduces a defect detection and recognition system of PCB bare board based on machine vision, and analyzes the overall design and composition principle of the system. The system consists of Renesas G2L embedded platform, X-Y axis mobile platform and high-definition industrial camera. Through the image preprocessing algorithm and the SSIM algorithm, the connected domain comparison is carried out to judge the fault. At the same time, the features such as the area of the connected domain are extracted and input into the BP neural network to judge the fault type, so as to realize the high-precision detection of the fault area, effectively identify the fault type and accurately locate the fault area. The overall system has good robustness.

articleTitle: Boosting Interpolation Consistency with Difference and Adaptive Threshold
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Interpolation consistency is a consistency regularization technique in semi-supervised learning (SSL), which encourages the model’s prediction of the interpolated samples to be consistent with the interpolation of the sample prediction by perturbing the samples with linear interpolation. However, this method only focus on having similar outputs for the same sample, while ignoring the differences between different samples. At the same time, in order to ensure that this consistent performance works effectively, it is usually necessary to set a fixed confidence threshold, which will cause some difficult samples to be unable to effectively participate in training. To this end, we propose a hybrid contrastive loss that strengthens the model’s attention to the differences between different samples, during consistent training. What’s more, we also design an adaptive threshold module, which sets a dynamic threshold by evaluating the current learning effect of each class, thus considering both easy samples and hard samples. Compared with existing semi-supervised methods, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on several standard datasets, especially on CIFAR-10 with 1000 labels and 4000 labels, which outperforms the current best results by 6.23% and 15.96% respectively.

articleTitle: Moving Target Detection Based On DLBSP For Complex Background Surveillance Video
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The robustness and efficiency of the most of existing target detection methods in complex background surveillance video could hardly meet the application requirements. To this, a novel background subtraction method based on Differential Local Binary Similarity Pattern (DLBSP) is proposed in this paper. Subsequently, a bi-feature model is constructed to enhance sample richness based on codebook construction combining texture and color. Furthermore, a hybrid modeling strategy, which could quickly construct a relatively ideal model with low maintenance cost is put forward to improve further the background modeling algorithm under complex background video with camera shake and background mutations. The comparative experiments on select seven categories (including 43 video sequences) of dataset CDnet2014 could demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method. It obtains better average FM detection results under complex background video containing dynamic backgrounds, sudden changes in lighting, and camera shakes.

articleTitle: An algorithm for locating reference points of cardiac motion signals based on non-contact
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Rich information of the human body is hidden in ECG signals about physiology and pathology, but contact ECG acquisition has limitations in our use of vital signs measurement and detection, non-contact millimeter wave radar has great potential in vital signs detection. In this paper, a two-sided sliding long and short window energy method is proposed. Based on the improvement of Pan-Tompkins algorithm, the AFP reference points are detected by adaptive threshold method and five-point differential method, and the other reference points are detected by state machine. We analyzed 50214 cardiac motion cycle signals of 24 subjects, extracted 60 cardiac motion cycles of M-type waveforms from each subject, and combined the data of sampling points of each cardiac motion cycle. We used this algorithm to test the error and accuracy of reference points.

Author Keywords: Bilateral sliding long and short window energy method

articleTitle: Clip Feature Extraction Method Based on 3D Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The detection of clip defects plays a decisive role in the safety of important infrastructure, but the clip parameters reach the micron level, and the accuracy and efficiency of traditional online detection methods cannot be balanced. In this paper, based on the three-dimensional measurement principle of linear structured light, a set of automatic acquisition system of three-dimensional point cloud data on the inner surface of the clip is constructed. Its horizontal resolution is 0.0635mm, and the elevation resolution is 0.00195mm. The collected data can completely characterize the characteristics of the inner surface of the clip. The profile data is used to restore the thread tooth with high accuracy, and its characteristic parameters are extracted. By comparing the design requirements of parameters, single section marks defects, and then all sections use fast connected domain analysis to mark point clouds to determine clip defects. The experiment shows that the extraction error of thread feature parameters is 0.04mm, the defect recognition rate is 98%, and the detection speed of a pair of clips is within 0.45s.

articleTitle: A study of EEG motor imagery classification algorithm based on WPD-AFBCSP
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: To improve the accuracy and reliability of EEG motor imagery classification, a WPD-AFBCSP-based EEG motor imagery classification algorithm is proposed. The algorithm first uses the wavelet packet decomposition (WPD) optimised adaptive filter bank co-space pattern algorithm (WPD-AFBCSP) to obtain multidimensional spatial features of the EEG signal, and then the optimal spatial features are obtained by feature selection with the mutual information (MI) feature selection algorithm. Finally, the feature matrix is fed into a deep neural network based on stacked auto-encoders(SAE) for left- and right-handed biclassification to achieve recognition of EEG motor imagery. The method achieves 89.3% classification accuracy on the BCI Competition II Data set III dataset, which can identify EEG motor imagery more effectively and provides a new method for the study of EEG motor imagery.

articleTitle: Comparison between the Traditional and Computerized Cognitive Training Programs in Treating Mild Cognitive Impairment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: MCI patients can be benefited from cognitive training programs to improve their cognitive capabilities or delay the decline of cognition. This paper evaluated three types of commonly seen categories of cognitive training programs (non-computerized / traditional cognitive training (TCT), computerized cognitive training (CCT), and virtual/augmented reality cognitive training (VR/AR CT)) based on six aspects: stimulation strength, user-friendliness, expandability, customizability/personalization, convenience, and motivation/atmosphere. In addition, recent applications of each type of CT were offered. Finally, a conclusion in which no single CT outperformed the others was derived, and the most applicable scenario of each type of CT was also provided.

articleTitle: STC-Net: Fusing Swin Transformer and Convolution Neural Network for 2D Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has made significant development in intelligent medical image analysis. However, due to the limitations of convolution, it cannot well learn a global and long sequence of semantic information, which also limits its performance in clinical medical segmentation. To solve the above problems, STC-Net proposed in this paper combines the global image information processed by Swin Transformer with the low-level detail features processed by CNN. To fuse the two kinds of information, a fusion module with channel attention mechanism and spatial attention mechanism (CSM) is proposed in the information fusion part of STC-Net. In the channel attention part, local channel information interaction is realized by the Fast 1D convolution method, while the spatial attention part focuses on important spatial location, scale and other information. The CSM can focus on this important information and suppress the non-target segmentation information. The results show that STC-Net achieves good performance in brain tumor segmentation, polyp segmentation and skin lesion segmentation.

articleTitle: The Method of Processing Abnormal Values for Flight Test Data Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In the flight test data, there usually are abnormal values due to uncertainties in acquisition, storage and transmission. Processing the abnormal values is essential to ensure the accuracy of subsequent test data analysis. In this paper, we propose an abnormal value processing method based on wavelet transform for flight test data. We use the summation of high- frequency wavelet details as the characteristic quantity for abnormal value detection. Moreover, the detection threshold is constructed based on the idea of constant false alarm detection to locate and process the abnormal values. Simulation results show that the method can detect and process the abnormal values in the time-series flight test data fast and accurately.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multidimensional Analytical Platform Based on Meteorological Infrastructure Resource Monitoring Big Data Service
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of meteorological intensification process, the infrastructure resources originally scattered by various business units are gradually incorporated into the national meteorological infrastructure resource pool for unified management. However, the incomplete registration of information, non-standardized content, and non-uniform standards of the original system pose great challenges to the multidimensional statistical analysis of infrastructure resources surveillance data after intensification. In order to rationalize the use of limited infrastructure resources, while being able to provide real-time data support basis for business decisions and management specifications, this paper designs and implements a multidimensional analysis platform for meteorological infrastructure resources monitoring big data. The platform can perform real-time statistical analysis of single-dimensional or multi-dimensional data by time, business unit, business system, resource category, etc. The relevant analysis results can be provided for real-time use by third-party business through subscription, interface, push, etc. The establishment of this platform provides an efficient technical solution to enhance the ability of infrastructure resources to monitor massive data analysis.

articleTitle: Radiation noise identification of gas leaks from underwater structures based on higher-order spectral features
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Underwater gas-tight structures will generate radiated noise when gas leaks, the identification of the radiation noise can be used to detect the presence of leaks in underwater structures and to remedy them at an early stage. The generation of gas leakage radiation noise is a very complex nonlinear process, so it is more difficult to make an accurate description and identification of it. An experimental environment is designed for the identification of gas leakage radiation noise from underwater structures, and a support vector machine identification method based on higher-order spectral features is proposed. Firstly, by extracting the higher-order spectrum of the signal, the signal features are made more prominent, thus improving the classification accuracy of the target recognition algorithm, and then the signal is classified based on the support vector machine to identify the gas leakage. The research results show that the method can effectively classify and identify simulated leakage targets, and has good prospects for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Scattering Parameters of Microwave Passive Components Based on Transfinite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, a numerical analysis method of scattering parameters (S-parameters) of passive microwave components based on transfinite element method (TFEM) is presented. The scattering parameters can be obtained directly and accurately combining the finite element method and transfinite-element boundary truncation of the ports. Compared with the results of the commercial software HFSS, the numerical results demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Piecewise adaptive sample learning based main lobe interference cancellation technique for rotating phased array radar
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Provided that the active interference enters the main lobe of rotating phased array radar, the interference suppression ability of the conventional sidelobe processing method degrades significantly. In this paper, a main-lobe interference high gain cancellation (AHGC) method based on piecewise adaptive sample learning is proposed. Firstly, the high gain cancellation channel and the cancellation approach are introduced. Then, the interference is reduced piecewise via segmenting the distance. The adaptive weights are optimized to achieve interference suppression by adaptive interference sample learning. Numerical results show that the high gain cancellation algorithm can effectively suppress the interference from the main lobe direction of the phased array radar, and the radar detection performance is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Design of a liquid crystal terahertz phased array
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Due to the lack of materials with suitable properties in the terahertz frequency band, the progress of terahertz devices and applications is quite difficult. The dielectric loss of liquid crystal materials decreases with the increase of the frequency band, and the dielectric properties are stable and the tuning rate is high in the terahertz frequency band. In this paper, an 1×4 terahertz phased array is proposed, which is integrated of phase shifter based on liquid crystal, antenna and power divider. The antenna array with a 12° half power lobe width and ±10° scanning angle simulated in HFSS, whose gain is 14.2dBi at 220GHz, and the SLL(sidelobe level) is -9dB. The antenna array shows well-matched, and the return loss is less than -10dB. The integrated design of phase shifter, dielectric rod antenna and multimode interference power divider is realized, which greatly reduces the cost of the phased array antenna and ensures stable dielectric performance in the terahertz frequency band.

articleTitle: The Key Technology of Configurable RF Front End
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: This paper discusses the requirement of software radar for digital RF transceiver. On this basis, a design idea of reconfigurable RF digital transceiver module with engineering realization is proposed, and the key technologies and feasibility of the system are analyzed and discussed in depth.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Intelligent Monitoring Device for Carbon Neutralization of Garden Plants Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: When fossil fuels are burned, a large amount of greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide can be produced, which then leads to extreme climate and environmental problems and threatens the survival and development of human beings. The timely realization of carbon neutrality requires advanced technical support. The Internet of Things integrates the functions of perception, transmission, processing and storage, which can predict and reduce carbon emissions, reduce energy consumption, save social resources and help to achieve "carbon neutrality". As the most important green ecological resource in high-density and economically developed areas, landscaping has indispensable carbon-neutral value and multiple ecosystem service functions, and will play an increasingly important role in promoting the development of green low-carbon and the realization of carbon-neutral vision. In this paper, the Internet of Things technology is used to realize the overall framework design of the intelligent monitoring device system for carbon neutrality. In order to optimize the construction and management of landscaping and enhance the contribution of landscaping to carbon neutrality.

articleTitle: Optimization of Speed Tracking Performance of LADRC for PMSM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Based on the mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous motor in synchronous rotating coordinate system, the first-order linear auto disturbance rejection controller of speed loop and current loop is designed. The introduction of the speed loop tracking differentiator solves the problem that the "quickness" and "overshoot" of the speed response of the conventional PID controller can not be taken into consideration at the same time, but it also leads to the decline of the tracking performance of the control system for the time-varying speed reference. Based on the classical linear tracking differentiator, the differential compensation of the transition process is introduced, and a new linear tracking differentiator is designed and applied to the speed loop auto disturbance rejection controller. The simulation proves that the improved auto disturbance rejection control strategy improves the tracking performance of the system for time-varying speed without affecting the anti-interference performance.

articleTitle: Research on distributed MIMO radar imaging technology based on compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The application scenario of radar and the imaging quality are closely related. In this paper, we propose a distributed MIMO radar array imaging technique for radar imaging resolution, which uses compressed sensing to reconstruct the radar echo signal for imaging, and can improve the imaging quality of MIMO radar. By simulating a single MIMO radar and a distributed MIMO radar model, the results show that the distributed MIMO radar model has higher imaging resolution than a single MIMO radar, especially with higher angular resolution.

articleTitle: A Signal Separation Method for Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Assisted Channel Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the estimation error of wireless channel parameters in complex electromagnetic environment is too large to meet the full rank channel matrix required for signal separation, this paper proposes a signal separation method based on reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) assisted channel regulation. The core idea of the method is to use the ability of RIS to reshape wireless channel parameters, and to achieve signal separation by actively designing the elements in the equivalent channel matrix to make the channel matrix full rank. Theoretical analysis and experimental simulation show that RIS array has the ability to adjust and control channel parameters, and the ability to modify wireless channel parameters can be used to achieve the separation of signals with the same frequency.

articleTitle: A Design Method of Ammunition Simulation Basic Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at the analysis and modeling of ammunition simulation basic model, this paper proposes a design method of ammunition simulation basic model, and realizes the software based on this method. This method simulates the flight, target search and recognition, hit and other processes of typical ammunition, which is composed of ammunition launch platform simulation basic model and ammunition simulation basic model.

articleTitle: A customer support resources allocation analysis method for civil aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Customer support is a key factor for the business and operation of civil aircraft. This study aims to determine how civil aircraft customer support could be more effective. This study analyzes and establishes a customer support calculation method for civil aircraft customers. Customers were divided into 5 categories and customer support relevance method were established, customer support resources could be allocated according to the method analysis results. The results showed four resources allocation plans for civil aircraft customer support: big customer support relevance was associated with more and urgent support resources than small ones. On this basis, the result should be taken into account when OEMs or their suppliers organize the on-site or remote supports for different civil aircraft customers.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Intelligent Emotion Perception Framework by Data-driven and Knowledge-guided
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the improvement of network environment quality and the enrichment of teaching content, video learning has become a powerful supplement to the normal teaching process. It is necessary to perceive the emotional states of the learners to improve the quality of video teaching and learning effects. In view of the particularity of online video learning, we analyzed and explored the factors that affect learners’ emotions, and proposed an intelligent emotion perception framework based on multimodal data-driven and knowledge-guided collaborative computing. Combining the physiological characteristics of learners with the semantic information about stimulus materials can more accurately and efficiently perceive the emotional state of online video learners.

articleTitle: Intelligent electricity consumption forecasting and electricity-theft analysis method based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Residential electricity consumption data have great mining value for electricity-theft analysis and electricity consumption forecasting. This paper designs an intelligent electricity consumption forecasting and electricity-theft analysis method based on deep learning. Firstly, the power consumption data of a single user is converted into multi-period data through preprocessing, and the data forecasting is realized by designing a deep neural network model. The electricity-theft data are first amplified through user’s power data and electricity-theft labels. And then the time series are converted into two-dimensional tensors for classification and recognition by deep CNN. The classification accuracy of electricity-theft reaches 92.2% compared with RNN method.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent language recommendation method based on emotion recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent language recommendation method based on emotion recognition is proposed, mainly including text data acquisition and preprocessing from Chinese reviews, text feature extraction based on word embedding, emotion classification model based on deep learning, attention mechanism, etc. The experimental results show that the Chinese comment sentiment analysis model based on deep neural network proposed in this paper can accurately determine the user’s emotions contained in the text comments, and can adapt to the Chinese scene well. At the same time, the model in this paper guarantees the recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: Evaluation of equipment storage reliability based on fusing of weak parts life data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The reliability or predicted storage life of equipment can be evaluated by testing the whole equipment. But the test cost is high and the test condition is harsh. To circumvent these problems, this paper proposes an evaluation method of equipment storage reliability based on data fusion technology of weak parts life. First weak parts life data can be obtained by weighted multi-source data based on analytic hierarchy process. Then the weak parts can be divided into two kinds of performance states: available and unavailable by using fuzzy performance state judgment method, the membership function is used to calculate the state membership degree of the weak parts, and the life data is converted to the probability value representing the performance state. On this basis, the reliability information fusion database of equipment typical weak parts need to be established. The overall reliability of equipment can be evaluated by Bayesian network combined with the Fault tree. Finally, the method is used to evaluate the storage reliability of an equipment and the effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: Research and simulation of radio reflection characteristics of sea surface in the S-band
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The electromagnetic wave will be reflected when encountering high and low waves during the propagation of the sea. The signal received by the wireless communication system receiver is composed of a direct signal and many reflected waves with different amplitude fading and phase. In this paper, for the S-band, the characterization parameters of sea surface electromagnetic characteristics and sea surface radio wave reflection characteristics - seawater dielectric constant and reflection coefficient are respectively studied, and their calculation methods are discussed. According to the change law, the main factors affecting its change and the aspects that should be paid attention to in the actual calculation are obtained. The research in this paper can provide a valuable reference for the study of the reflection characteristics of sea surface radio waves.

articleTitle: On Automatic Scoring Algorithm for Subjective Questions based on LSA and Dependency Parsing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of lack of sample data and unknown words often seen in the development of automatic scoring system for subjective questions, we propose an automatic scoring algorithm based on latent semantic analysis and dependency parsing for subjective questions. First, the questions, standard answers and candidates' answers are used as corpus for latent semantic analysis training to generate document vectors and word vectors. Then, the standard answers and candidates' answers are divided into sentences, and the sentences are analysed by dependency parsing. Then, the document vectors, word vectors and dependency parsing results are used as the input of the automatic scoring algorithm, three automatic scoring schemes are proposed according to the number of sentences and their differences between the standard answer and the candidates' answer. The experimental results show that this algorithm has obvious advantages and potential value compared with the control method.

articleTitle: Features Domains and Classification Algorithms in Motor Imagery Brain Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) is well approved to help people with movement impairments due to neural disorders. The procedure for MI-BCI to translate MI brain signals to understandable instructions for external devices involves extracting features from recorded signals and predicting desired movements. This paper summarizes and compares feature extraction methods and classification algorithms and their modifications that are commonly used for MI EEG signals. Feature extraction techniques are discussed based on their feature domains: time, frequency, and spatial. Classification algorithms are divided into classical machine learning and deep learning. This paper aims to provide a straightforward view of common ways to extract features and classifying movements in MI-BCI and show difficulties in MI-BCI signal processing. The nature of MI EEG signals and MI-BCI applications points to several promising field such as transfer learning and deep learning neural networks.

articleTitle: Research on noise suppression method of brain information perception system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: As a typical physiological electrical signal, EEG signal has several characteristics include weak at amplitude, low SNR(Signal-Noise Ratio), susceptible to interference, low frequency, narrow frequency range, strong randomness, etc.<sup>[1]</sup>. The interference of external electromagnetic signal may cause to a situation of degradation in signal quality, even leads to the failure of brain information perception system’s operation. Therefore, we need to analyze the electromagnetic environment’s characteristics during the process of brain information perception system acquisition and circumvent system’s disadvantages. In this paper, we analyzed the spectral characteristics of noise sources that affect brain information perception system, given several effective noise suppression methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Indoor Temperature and Humidity Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: This project designed an indoor climate control system. The control items include temperature and humidity, which solves the shortcomings of traditional temperature and humidity control equipment. The system adopts wireless communication technology and control algorithms. The hardware devices used include sensors, wireless modules, and single-chip microcomputers. The system finally achieves real-time detection of changes in indoor temperature and humidity parameters and maintains the effect of suitable temperature and humidity through air conditioners and humidifiers.

articleTitle: Electronic Approaches to Vision Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Vision is very important for human beings, because people use vision to get information from the outside world while visual impairment and eye illnesses are widespread and frequently untreated. Based on the perception of the magnitude of the problem, three primary techniques for implanting retinal prostheses were analyzed and discussed in this article. The benefits and drawbacks of each of these three retinal prostheses were also compared. Though each of the three has its own merits, but it is believed that all three strategies will develop to satisfy difficult and particular surgical requirements and help more patients with visual impairment. In the future, all three strategies will develop to satisfy difficult and particular surgical requirements.

articleTitle: Neuromodulation Based Visual Restoration Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Visual restoration is to consciously create a good visual environment and auxiliary equipment for patients with low vision, provide various viewing opportunities and visual stimulation, encourage patients to overcome the psychological barriers caused by visual defects, help patients master visual skills and skills, learn visual operations, Improve the ability to utilize residual vision. Technologies such as neuromodulation seem to provide us with infinite possibilities, but at the same time, they also bring many uncertainties, forcing rehabilitation clinicians and researchers to conduct in-depth research on evidence-based medicine and rehabilitation theory. In the discussion of neuromodulation-based visual restoration methods, the visual pathway and restoration principles are first introduced, and then the neuromodulation methods for visual restoration are studied. Neuromodulation in the acute phase. As a category A recommendation, it is worth exploring and trying, and further summarizing and improving from clinical practice. Systematic training can often expand the visual field of patients with residual vision, and at least improve the visual function of patients with central scotoma or hemianopia.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Operation and Maintenance System for Information Security Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor communication, low efficiency and poor service quality in information operation and security management, a Web-based intelligent information security operation and maintenance system is proposed. Adopting SOA (service-oriented architecture) architecture and based on IitLL (information technology infrastructure library) technology, an integrated management system of information security operation and maintenance services is established to meet business and management requirements. The system is mainly composed of data acquisition layer, summary analysis layer and presentation layer, and realizes three management functions: business operation, operation and maintenance services and information security. Through configuration management tracking and intelligent log analysis, the automatic collection, analysis and early warning of information security incidents are realized, which provides a basis for dealing with all kinds of incidents. The application shows that the system realizes the unified scheduling of operation and maintenance human resources, and realizes the unified management and process standardization of information security and operation and maintenance services through real-time monitoring of business systems and infrastructure. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition Based on Improved AlexNet
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Gesture recognition is one of the research hotspots in the field of computer science and technology today, aiming to establish a natural and harmonious human-computer interaction environment and a colorful interaction mode. The application range of gesture recognition is very wide: gesture recognition can not only help deaf people to solve interaction problems, but also be applied in various fields such as daily life, education, business office, etc. Meanwhile, gesture recognition technology is also needed in the more popular metaverse recently. Handcrafted methods for vision-based gesture recognition usually involve multiple stages of professional processing, such as traditional handcrafted-based feature extraction methods, which are generally used to specialize in specific tasks with insufficient generalization capability. For this reason, this paper proposes an improved AlexNet-based gesture recognition algorithm by stacking four 3×3 convolutional kernels instead of the 11×11 convolutional kernels in AlexNet. In addition, the number of training data is increased and its diversity is enriched by preprocessing such as random cropping and random level flipping to further improve the generalization ability of the algorithm. The improved algorithm proposed in this paper further enhances the feature extraction capability of the network, and the experiments are conducted on multiple datasets, i.e., one American Sign Language dataset and two NUS gesture datasets. The average accuracy of the improved algorithm is 95.3%, which is better than the original AlexNet network as well as other deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Security Based on Big Data and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: As 5G is deployed and applied, a large number of mobile devices have been increasingly deployed on the network. Scenarios such as smartphones, smart car, smart transportation, smart wearable devices, and smart industry are increasingly demanding for networks. And the Internet of Things (IoT), as a new and high technology, will play an important role and generate huge economic benefits. However, IoT security also faces many challenges due to the inherent security vulnerabilities in multiple device interactions and the data also needs more accurate processing. Big data and deep learning have been gradually applied in various industries. Therefore, we have summarized and analyzed the use of big data and deep learning technology to solve the hidden dangers of the IoT security under the consideration of some suggestions and thinking for industry applications.

articleTitle: Research on aircraft platform environment data preprocessing process
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The preprocessing of aircraft random vibration samples is critical to the formulation of environmental test conditions. This paper briefly reviews the phenomenon of singularity and trend term in random vibration sample data firstly. This paper describes the software system we developed and introduces the data storage and acquisition process based on Hadoop in detail secondly. Then the paper We summarize the relevant algorithms for identifying data outliers, including MATLAB-based visual inspection of data, probability density curves, narrowband spectral density curves, and algorithms for removing outliers, including least squares, intermittent noise outlier removal, IIR. Finally, the paper points out that data analysis process to generate spectrum, data conclude process, test conditions are for future research work.

articleTitle: Improvement of Chaotic Image Encryption Method Based on LDPC Code
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Chaotic image encryption algorithm based on Low-Density Parity-Check (LDPC) code algorithm has the problem of high complexity and poor real-time performance. We choose the quasi-cyclic Low-Density Parity-Check (QC-LDPC) code instead of the Gallagher code in the algorithm and achieve better results than the previous one, especially in high-intensity noise. The watermark obtained by this method has high attack resistance and more resource saving in hardware. The QC-LDPC used in this paper is a code word constructed by the Fibonacci sequence, which has the advantages of small storage space, high flexibility, and high performance. Its excellent performance is also proved by its application in digital watermarking technology, which provides a reference for applying LDPC codes in more directions. Meanwhile, the practical applicability of LDPC digital image watermarking is further improved.

articleTitle: Disaster Vulnerability Analysis of Hospital Functional Logistics Department Based on Improved Kaiser Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Through the analysis of hospital disaster vulnerability in the functional logistics department of the hospital, the disaster events faced by the hospital are identified, and the logistics functional department is guided to carry out emergency response work. According to the modified Kaiser model, the relative risk values of 18 hospital risk factors were calculated and ranked. The top 5 risk events obtained by calculation are high temperature 22.02%, flood 19.97%, typhoon/tornado 19.20%, power failure 18.64%, and elevator accidental failure 18.53%. The improved Kaiser model provides a scientific method for the disaster vulnerability analysis of the hospital’s functional logistics department, which can promote the hospital to carry out targeted emergency drills and continuously improve the hospital’s emergency management system.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of the AGV Forklift
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: This article analyses the longitudinal and lateral stability of an AGV forklift during the loading, carrying and unloading process. Using the dynamic model presented under the equilibrium conditions, a mathematical model of the forklift was constructed and the normal reaction forces acting on the front and rear wheels and the positions of the center of gravity in the safety zone were studied. A virtual prototype was created and tested in an MSC ADAMS application environment.

articleTitle: Applications of Brain Co-processor
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Due to the widespread usage of the Brain Computer Interface (BCI) technology, researchers are concentrating more on developing methods to encode and input brain signals from external devices. Therefore, the Brain Co-processor, which integrates encoding and decoding between the brain and external equipment, has become an ideal option. As a result, this paper outlines the use of the Brain Co-processor in both medical and non-medical applications in accordance with the fundamental principle behind them. Based on the characteristics of the Brain Co-processor, this paper applies the results of these studies to applications such as brain recovery and enhancement through the study of the relationship between the brain and external devices, the study of specific areas of the brain, the study of electrical stimulation of the brain and the change of brain signals, and offers potential possibilities in the future. Researchers can provide a broad prospect for the current and potential applications of the Brain Co-processor by dialectically summarizing, comparing, and analogizing the summarized applications in this passage.

articleTitle: Mechanical Resonance Suppression Based on Sliding Window FFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In the process of suppressing mechanical resonance, adaptive notch filter is a common method, and the center frequency of notch filter is usually obtained by using fast Fourier transform to transform the time domain signal into the frequency domain signal for analysis. The traditional FFT algorithm can’t suppress the mechanical resonance accurately and quickly due to the large amount of calculation and the introduction of response delay, which is difficult to achieve in the real-time communication system. In this paper, a sliding window FFT real-time algorithm is proposed, which makes full use of the calculation results of the front window, reduces the calculation amount, improves the real-time performance of spectrum analysis, and can quickly suppress the resonance. Finally, the theoretical analysis and simulation show that this method can effectively and quickly analyze the spectrum.

articleTitle: Based on the self-developed high-frequency electromagnetic simulation named Emlab, a new type of ultra-wideband small antenna for mobile terminals is designed
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In the design of passive devices such as antennas and filters, simulation verification can improve the accuracy and yield of the final design. It is important to have a fully autonomous EDA software. Depending on that, our laboratory developed a high-frequency electromagnetic solver called Emlab based on the theory of finite method. This solver has a series of functions such as modeling, solving high-frequency electromagnetic problems, and post-processing. We can independently design our microwave passive components using it. We also can know that MIMO and UWB technologies are the key technologies of 5G. This paper that combing with practical application scenarios designs an ultra-wideband small mobile terminal MIMO antenna using some new structures by Emlab, and compares its calculation results with HESS, which finds that it has good agreement with HESS.

articleTitle: Research on two-dimensional code scanning and automatic recording device for human body temperature measurement based on stm32
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the outbreak and normal development of COVID-19, the effective detection and recording of body temperature has become a new focus of our attention. At present, there is no complete system to measure temperature, automatic record and specific information at home and abroad. To this end, combined with professional knowledge, our team designed a two-dimensional code scanning and human body temperature automatic recording device with STM32F1 as the core. The device STM32F1 development board is the main control chip. By connecting the WIFI module through the serial port, STM32F1 uses the function of wireless communication. Through the communication protocol, the link between the router and the ESC cloud server of Ali Cloud is utilized. The router or mobile data is transmitted to the user side (APP, applets) according to the specified communication protocol. Inside the development board, the code of each part is written to complete the device integrating code scanning and temperature measurement, which can be displayed and alarm through the node (OLED display screen). This will play a good role in preventing the spread of COVID-19. The system can be used in hospitals, communities, railway stations, shopping malls and many other public places.
