articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Population Forecast Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: According to the non-linear characteristics of population data. The BP neural network model for population prediction in China is established by analyzing and studying the structure design, number of neurons, transfer function and other aspects of the model. Based on the population data from 1961 to 2021 in China, the model was trained and simulated using MATLAB software. The results show that the trained model has high prediction accuracy and can be used for prediction. Finally, the training model is used to predict the population of China in the next 20 years. The results of the study can provide valuable reference for the decision-making of relevant departments.

articleTitle: Target detection method based on Cameron decomposition and Hilbert-Huang transform roughness
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the difficult problem of small target detection such as missing a priori conditions, small radar scattering cross section in complex environment and sea surface clutter interference causes the Doppler frequency range of small targets to overlap with the clutter. This paper uses the characteristic difference between target and clutter in polarized scattering, a target unit detection method based on the concept of Hilbert-Huang transform spectral ridge line roughness after Cameron decomposition is proposed. Using this algorithm, the distinction between target and clutter is finally achieved for target detection;The accuracy of small target detection is improved, and the method of distinguishing small targets from complex backgrounds is effectively implemented. According to the validation of the measured IPIX radar data set, the algorithm has good detection effect in different data segments and different signal-to-noise ratios.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Mixed Model Assembly Line Scheduling Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, the scheduling problem of mixed model assembly line is studied. By analyzing the key objectives of mixed model assembly line scheduling, the modeling principle is determined, and the multi-objective optimization model of mixed model assembly line scheduling is constructed with the goal of homogenizing the consumption rate of parts and minimizing the maximum processing cycle. The genetic algorithm is used to select appropriate algorithm parameters to solve the model, and the optimal scheduling sequence scheme is obtained, An example is given to prove the correctness and effectiveness of the optimal scheduling results.

articleTitle: Design of Cloud technology monitoring blind zone alert system for irregular areas
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of cloud technology, for the irregular area monitoring equipment distribution is uneven, there are monitoring blind areas, resulting in difficult information collection, investigation and tracking, and security risks, the use of alert system can find out the monitoring blind areas in irregular areas, can achieve the rapid alarm of the people to the sudden or emergency situation, and the system will use cloud technology to build a local area network to search for all the nearby cameras to turn angle face of the area for video surveillance and video recording. In this paper, through literature method, analysis method and system method, we retrieve the data of the existing surveillance equipment in the irregular area, select more mature and practical hardware and software, distribute terminal equipment evenly in the irregular area, use infrared technology to reasonably detect the surveillance blind zone, and design the surveillance blind zone alert system. The system provides a detailed description of how to design the system in accordance with the overall design of the surveillance blind zone alert system, the hardware design of the alert system, the software design of the alert system, and the application prospect of the alert system, providing a theoretical basis and application scope for the next development of the surveillance blind zone alert system.

articleTitle: Combination of Virtual Reality and Brain Computer Interface Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The application of systems combining virtual reality and brain-computer interface has gained lots of attention. In this paper, we studied three types of combined systems using namely motor imaginary, steady-state visual evoked potential, and P300. A comparison between these systems in setup, usage, and performance will be made. It can be concluded that rehabilitation is usually the purpose to develop these systems though there exist other applicable fields. The motor imaginary system is often connected to movement ability with no visual stimulation needed and more training requirements. The other two types of combined systems have a closer relationship with eyes with a higher information transfer rate but stimulations given visually are needed. Issues related to virtual reality in the application will then be discussed such as visual discomfort. This paper points out some possible directions for the future development of these combined systems such as improving sample size and reducing training requirements.

articleTitle: Digital portrait model construction for telemedicine doctor authentication
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In the remote diagnosis and treatment scenarios of telemedicine, there are various authentication elements that are not credible, and the traditional doctor authentication methods cannot realize the problem of credible authentication. The article combines conventional authentication technology and user portrait technology, and proposes a continuous authentication and abnormal behavior monitoring technology based on doctor user portraits. The article obtains the property labels by analyzing the basic attributes of doctors and the behavior labels by mining the frequent access sequences of doctors using the Prefixspan algorithm, and constructs a digital portrait of doctor users by combining the property labels and behavior labels. The experimental results show that the implementation of continuous identity authentication and abnormal behavior monitoring technology based on the digital portrait of user authentication effectively improves the authentication problem under the condition of untrustworthy authentication elements and enhances the security of the telemedicine service platform.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Based Semantic Table Annotation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Semantic Table Annotation (STI) represents the process of annotating tabular data with concepts and relationships in a given knowledge graph. In recent years, there has been a lot of work on this task with excellent results. However, in the face of real table data with more and more naming rules and type relationships in the real world, many existing semantic table annotation systems based on unsupervised patterns cannot efficiently extract the deep features of the data for table cell matching. To efficiently extract complex features from real tabular data, in this paper, we propose a deep learning-based semantic table annotation system capable of completing table cell annotation using a fine-tuned deep learning model. Moreover, we also propose a new iterative matching framework to improve the annotation capability and work efficiency of the system. The framework expands the neighbor information on the knowledge graph and completes the matching of multiple cell targets through one query, which improves the work efficiency of the system. More importantly, the framework uses the results of column pair annotation to re-annotate target cells, check and correct cell annotation errors, and improve the system’s annotation capabilities. Our table annotation system achieves above-average results on two evaluation datasets from SemTab2021, and the extraction of real data features exceeds that of expert feature engineering. Moreover, our system also achieves good results on the real dataset of DBpedia.

articleTitle: Can Laser Speckle Contrast Imaging be a quantitative measurement using machine learning?
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Laser speckle contrast blood flow imaging (LSCI) analyzes the spatial or temporal statistical characteristics of laser speckle patterns to obtain a signal proportional to blood flow. As it can achieve real time blood flow imaging at high resolution with simple instrumental setup, LSCI has been widely applied in both clinic and research. The lack of quantitative blood flow measurement is the primary limitation. Efforts have been made to optimize LSCI from the aspects of measurement accuracy and linearity such as multi-exposure laser speckle contrast imaging (MELSCI) and AI-based (artificial intelligence) LSCI. This paper reviews LSCI in terms of basic principles, system development and quantitative measurement of LSCI. The application of machine learning in LSCI is discussed in detail. By comparing the estimated perfusion results of LSCI, MELSCI and LDI (laser Doppler blood flow imaging), we propose that using machine learning to correct LSCI to MELSCI has great potential for improving measurement linearity while retaining system simplicity.

articleTitle: Interference Identification Method for UAV Based on Improved Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: To improve the interference suppression ability of the UAV data link system, it is necessary to accurately identify various interference signals in complex electromagnetic environments. Support vector machine (SVM) is widely used in the field of interference identification, but its classification performance is greatly affected by parameter selection. Therefore, in order to solve the problem of low interference identification accuracy in the traditional SVM algorithm, an improved SVM algorithm based on Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) is proposed. The method optimizes the penalty factor and kernel function parameters of the SVM algorithm through SSA, which improves the classification accuracy and efficiency of the algorithm. Simulation results show that the identification performance of the proposed SSA-SVM algorithm is better than the traditional SVM and random forest algorithms. When the interference-to-noise ratio is 0dB, six kinds of UAV interference signals can be accurately identified. In addition, the identification accuracy is also significantly improved at low signal-to-noise ratios. For compound interference, the SSA-SVM algorithm also shows good identification performance. When the interference-to-noise ratio is greater than 2dB, 15 types of compound interference signals can be accurately identified.

articleTitle: Research on Microservice Access Control Model Based on Behavior Information in B5G Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the development of mobile communication networks, the trend of microservices in core networks is becoming more and more obvious. The open and distributed characteristics make it face serious security problems, such as unauthorized access and malicious intrusion. Aim at the above-mentioned problems, this paper proposes a behavioral information-based microservice access control model in the B5G scenario. Then, the article introduces in detail the state evaluation algorithm based on behavior chain and the dynamic evaluation algorithm based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) in the access control model. Finally, the effectiveness of the access control model proposed in this paper is verified by a comparative experiment with the current authentication scheme. The experimental results show that the access control model proposed in this paper is more resistant to diverse attacks and more adaptable to complex microservice environments.

articleTitle: Joint early warning model of power supply side personnel safety based on visual analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: In order to get rid of the ineffective manual supervision mode of helmet wearing detection and construction personnel cross-border behavior detection in the supply side, and give early warning of dangerous behavior in time, a joint warning model of power supply side construction personnel safety based on visual analysis is proposed. The model consists of a feature extraction module and an association detection module. The feature extraction module extracts the features of helmet wearing, personnel position, and edge position, utilizing the Yolov5 network and edge detection. The association detection module analyzes the multimodal input and judges the binary relationship between personnel and boundary. The experimental results reveal that the average detection speed of the helmet detection part using yolov5s is 111fps, and the mAP is 95.8%, which can fully meet the needs of real-time detection. Meanwhile, the model is capable to effectively detect and warn the illegal transgressions of people on straight and curve tracks and migrate to other similar scenes.

articleTitle: Extend quantum homomorphic encryption scheme based on Brown state
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: Quantum fully homomorphic encryption (QFHE) is a kind of secure method which allows random evaluation computations performed by each server on the cipher states and do not decrypt them. In order to extend the QFHE scheme for three-participant, an extend QFHE scheme based on brown state is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the conception of extend means we use a state which are familiar in quantum secret sharing procedure to extend the former QFHE scheme with three-part. Secondly, universal quantum circuit (UQC) enables random quantum transformations on the cipher states which promise the security, and the key-updating algorithms are also secure because of the former UQC. Finally, due to the property of QFHE, we do not need any security check to make it efficient for the secret sharing procedure.

articleTitle: Guaranteed Network Risk Rating Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: The mutual guarantee between enterprises is inseparable from their financing activities. The formation of the guarantee circle makes the originally unconnected companies closely interdependent, which means the operational risk of an enterprise in the circle will be transmitted layer by layer along the guarantee chain and eventually lead to systemic risks in the industry or even in a region. The market supervision and management department should supervise whether the contracting parties in the guaranteed network are in a state of "tripartite confrontation." Once negative effects are triggered, they will affect not only the company’s performance but also opportunistic behaviors in the market and even economic foresight. This paper proposes a risk assessment model based on a graph neural network. This model employs the community discovery algorithm and graph neural network to extract a large number of guarantee data from the original table representing "see-to-it" guarantee, principal and collateral relationships of guarantee and start time. Then takes the guarantee subject as a node and traverses the community labels of all neighbors, so as to, convert it into a guaranteed network and use the model established based on the graph neural network to rate its risk. The experimental results demonstrate that the model is effective and practical for identifying special guarantee circles, and that it can be utilized as a reference in extracting topology network structure and detecting the community structure of the static graph.

articleTitle: DRLFCfuzzer: fuzzing with Deep-Reinforcement-Learning under Format Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Technology (EIECT)
abstract: With the development of information technology, program vulnerabilities have become more complex and diversified, posing a great threat to the security of computer systems. Among many vulnerability detection methods, fuzzing is an popular method of automatic vulnerability mining which efficiency depends on the quality of generated samples. Some work has introduced reinforcement learning into fuzzing to provide an intelligent scheme for vulnerability mining, but there is still the problem of exploring invalid sample space. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a new fuzzer called DRLFCfuzzer, which is based on data boundary segmentation technology and guided by multi-dimensional deep reinforcement learning. We model the fuzzing process as a Markov decision process, add the segmentation of data boundaries and the selection of data blocks on the basis of multi-dimensional mutation, and improve the efficiency of the fuzzing by pruning unnecessary exploration of sample spaces. The experimental results show that DRLFCfuzzer achieves code coverage of 128% to 800% of AFL and 112% to 160% of general deep reinforcement learning fuzzer and more crashes in some programs of the Fuzzer-Test-Suite dataset and three real world programs.
